json.text: Operational Governance Control Policy Management controls for ownership deadlines escalations and continuous improvement across the ZeroGap process NordCare Pflegekasse LongTerm Care Claims Operations 1 Purpose This policy defines the management controls that govern the endtoend longterm care application process at NordCare Pflegekasse covering ownership deadline compliance escalation handling and continuous improvement across the completenesscheck deadlinemanagement casehandover and objectionhandling procedures 2 Governance Objectives Ensure clear singlepoint accountability for every case at every process stage Maintain compliance with statutory commissioning and decision deadlines Detect and escalate atrisk or noncompliant cases before statutory consequences are triggered Provide management visibility into process performance through a consistent agreed KPI set Drive continuous improvement by identifying and addressing recurring root causes of delay or rework 3 Proposed KPI Set KPI Definition Target illustrative threshold applications with complete order info on first check Share of applications where the ZeroGap Agents first completeness check finds all mandatory order information present with no missinginformation request required Illustrative 85 Average time to issue missinginformation request Average elapsed time from confirmed identification of a completeness gap to dispatch of the missinginformation request to the applicant Illustrative 1 working day assessment orders transmitted within 3 working days Share of cases where the assessment order is transmitted to the Medical Service within the statutory 3workingday commissioning window Illustrative 98 decisions issued within applicable deadline Share of cases where the written care decision notice is issued within the applicable deadline type 5 10 25 working days accounting for any valid pause Illustrative 95 Count value of 70perweek penalty payments Number of cases triggering the statutory penalty for a missed decision deadline and the total value paid per reporting period Illustrative tracked target trend downward Repeatrequest rate Share of cases requiring more than one missinginformation request before the order information is judged complete Illustrative below 10 Targets shown are illustrative thresholds for demonstration purposes only and have not been validated against NordCares actual operating performance or agreed management targets 4 Control Ownership Case Handler Sachspezialist für Pflege owns caselevel control execution including completeness checks deadline monitoring and handover discipline for assigned cases ZeroGap Agent executes the automated completeness check and surfaces deadlinerisk flags for Case Handler and Team Lead review Decision Intelligence Agent executes the Gutachten plausibility check and drafts the benefitentitlement determination for Case Handler review Team Lead owns operational escalation handling and daytoday performance monitoring across a team of cases Process Owner owns the overall control framework KPI reporting penalty tracking and approval of any change to the process or its controls 5 Issue Improvement Management 1 Identify the issue through KPI monitoring escalation records penalty triggers or direct casehandler feedback 2 Log the issue with the affected cases process stage and observed impact 3 Conduct rootcause analysis distinguishing oneoff case errors from systemic process data or agentperformance causes 4 Define and assign a corrective action with an owner and target completion date 5 Implement the corrective action and verify its effect against the relevant KPI over the following reporting period 6 Record the resolved issue and its root cause in the governance log for trend analysis 6 Records Evidence Caselevel logs of completeness checks deadline clock events handovers and objection outcomes Monthly KPI reporting pack including penalty payment tracking Escalation records with trigger action taken and owner Issue and improvement log with root causes and corrective actions 7 Policy Governance This policy and the KPI targets and control ownership it describes are illustrative and fictitious prepared for internal demonstration purposes as part of a consulting engagement They do not represent an approved operational policy and must be reviewed and approved by a designated Process Owner with input from Legal and Compliance before any operational use Illustrative fictitious document prepared for internal demonstration purposes NordCare Pflegekasse is a fictitious insurer Not an approved operational policy

json.name: document 6
json.text: Case Handover Ownership Protocol Controlled transfer of a case between Input Output Management the Case Handler the Medical Service and the Decision Intelligence Agent NordCare Pflegekasse LongTerm Care Claims Operations 1 Purpose This protocol defines how ownership of a longterm care case is transferred in a controlled traceable manner between the functions and agents involved in processing an application from intake through to decision and where applicable objection handling It ensures that at every point in the process exactly one party is accountable for the case 2 Scope Applies to every application for determination or change of longterm care need Pflegebedürftigkeit handled by NordCare Pflegekasse from receipt of the Antrag to case closure Covers handovers between Input Output Management the Case Handler the Medical Service MD the Decision Intelligence Agent and where an objection is raised the objectionhandling function Does not cover the Medical Services own internal assessment workflow which is a thirdparty activity outside NordCares operational control 3 Ownership Model Input Output Management owns the case from receipt of the application until the Case Handler has created the case record and confirmed applicant identification The Case Handler Sachspezialist für Pflege owns the case from case creation through deadlinetype determination confirmation letter dispatch information gathering and completeness checking up to transmission of the assessment order Ownership passes to the Medical Service MD for the duration of the assessment NordCare retains monitoring responsibility but not operational control during this period The Case Handler resumes ownership on return of the assessment report Gutachten and assignment of the Gutachten to the case The Decision Intelligence Agent holds working ownership of the plausibility check and draft benefitentitlement determination under the Case Handlers supervision until the benefit decision is documented The Case Handler owns issuance dispatch and archiving of the care decision notice Pflegebescheid Where an objection Widerspruch is submitted ownership passes to the objectionhandling function on receipt and triage of the objection 4 When a Handover Is Required The case moves from intake Input Output Management to case handling Case Handler The assessment order is transmitted to the Medical Service The Gutachten is returned by the Medical Service and assigned to the case The Decision Intelligence Agents plausibility check and draft decision are handed to the Case Handler for review and finalization The benefit decision is documented and the care decision notice is generated sent and archived closing the case An objection is received and the case is triaged to the objectionhandling function 5 Mandatory Handover Package Case reference and applicant identification Current process stage and status eg awaiting MD assessment Gutachten received decision drafted Actions completed to date with dates and the responsible party for each Open items and any outstanding requests eg a missinginformation request still awaiting a response Applicable due date deadline type and current pauseresume status per the Deadline Escalation Procedure Named sending owner and named receiving owner both explicitly acknowledging the transfer 6 Handover Procedure 1 The sending owner assembles the mandatory handover package described in Section 5 and attaches it to the case record 2 The sending owner confirms the case is in a consistent state no unresolved data conflicts all completed actions logged before initiating the handover 3 The receiving owner reviews the handover package and either accepts ownership or returns the case with a documented reason if the package is incomplete 4 On acceptance the case management system timestamps the change of ownership and records both the sending and receiving owner 5 Where the Decision Intelligence Agent is the receiving party its output remains subject to Case Handler review before any decision is finalized agent output is never transmitted to the applicant unattended 6 The sending owner remains available to answer clarifying questions for a reasonable period after handover particularly where the Medical Service or the applicant requests clarification on information supplied before the handover 7 Ownership During Repeat Assessments and Objections Where a repeat assessment Wiederholungsbegutachtung is triggered the Case Handler who owned the original case retains ownership of the new assessment cycle where practicable to preserve continuity of case knowledge a formal handover under Section 6 still applies if the case is reassigned to a different Case Handler Where an objection is received ownership passes to the objectionhandling function but the original Case Handlers case history the Gutachten and the documented benefit decision must be included in full in the handover package since the objection review depends on this record 8 Closure Criteria The care decision notice has been sent and archived or the objection process if any has reached a final outcome All handovers relevant to the case are logged with sending owner receiving owner and timestamp No open items remain unresolved at the point of closure The complete case record including the Gutachten and the documented benefit decision is retained per NordCares recordsretention rules 9 Roles Input Output Management scans classifies and triages incoming documents owns the case until initial case creation Case Handler Sachspezialist für Pflege primary case owner across most of the process accepts and initiates handovers makes final decisions on agentdrafted output ZeroGap Agent supports the Case Handler during the informationgathering and completenesscheck stages not itself a case owner Decision Intelligence Agent checks the plausibility of the Gutachten and drafts the benefitentitlement determination for Case Handler review holds working not final ownership Team Lead resolves disputed or rejected handovers between functions Process Owner monitors handover completeness and timeliness across the endtoend process 10 Legal Regulatory References 18 Abs 1 SGB XI the insurer must commission the Medical Service within 3 working days of application receipt which sets the latest point by which the Case Handler must have completed the intaketocasehandling handover 18 Abs 4 SGB XI the insurer must supply the Medical Service with the documents necessary for the assessment the handover package to the Medical Service stage must reflect this obligation 18c Abs 2 SGB XI the care decision notice must present and explain the Gutachten result transparently the handover from the Decision Intelligence Agent to the Case Handler must preserve the information needed to meet this requirement Illustrative fictitious document prepared for internal demonstration purposes NordCare Pflegekasse is a fictitious insurer Not an approved operational policy

json.name: document 7
json.text: Completeness Check MissingInformation Work Instruction Verifying mandatory order information before commissioning the Medical Service MD NordCare Pflegekasse LongTerm Care Claims Operations 1 Purpose This work instruction defines how case handlers and the ZeroGap completenesscheck capability verify that an incoming longterm care application contains the mandatory order information required to commission the Medical Service Medizinischer Dienst MD with the determination of care need It applies from case creation up to transmission of the assessment order 2 Scope Applies to all applications for initial determination or change of longterm care need Pflegebedürftigkeit received by NordCare Pflegekasse Covers process steps gather casespecific information check completeness of mandatory order information request missing information where required and generatetransmit the assessment order Does not cover the Medical Services own assessment process which is a thirdparty activity outside NordCares operational control 3 Mandatory Order Information Stammdaten The Medical Service Bund MDBund assessment guidelines specify the minimum data set an insurer must hold before it may commission an assessment The fields below reflect that mandatory set as currently implemented in NordCares intake process Data field Description Source Insurer care fund reference NordCare Pflegekasse casehandling entity and member number under which the application is registered Applicant record Applicant identification Full name date of birth sex and current address of the person for whom care need is being assessed Antrag form Application reference number Unique case ID assigned at intake used to link all subsequent correspondence and the assessment order Case system Date of application receipt Calendar date the application was logged as received anchors both the 3workingday commissioning clock and the applicable decision clock Case system Applicant contact details Telephone andor emailpostal address for the applicant or their authorized representative for confirmation and followup correspondence Antrag Fragebogen Authorized representative details if applicable Name and proof of authority Vollmacht where the application is filed by a legal guardian or appointed representative Supporting document Requested assessment type Initial classification changereassessment Höherstufung or repeat assessment Wiederholungsbegutachtung Antrag form Deadlinetype indicator Flag for expedited handling hospitalinpatient rehabilitation 5 working days or home care with announced Pflegezeit 10 working days otherwise standard 25 working days Fristtyp determination Consent datasharing acknowledgement Confirmation that the applicant has been informed of data transfer to the Medical Service for assessment purposes Antrag form This checklist is illustrative and reproduces the category structure of the MDBund mandatory data set Antragsinformationen Stammdaten Anlage 1 to the BegutachtungsRichtlinien It must be validated against the current published Anlage 1 before any operational use 4 Completeness Check Procedure 1 Retrieve the case file created at intake and confirm the applicant has been identified without ambiguity no unresolved duplicate or conflicting case 2 Compare the case file against the mandatory order information checklist in Section 3 field by field 3 Where the ZeroGap Agent performs the check review its completeness result and confidence flags before relying on them for a missinginformation decision 4 If every mandatory field is present and consistent mark the case ready for order transmission and proceed to Section 6 of the Deadline Escalation Procedure 5 If any mandatory field is missing unreadable or contradictory eg mismatched applicant name between the application and an identity document mark the case incomplete and proceed to Section 5 6 Record the completeness outcome the fields checked and the reviewer or agent identifier in the case log 5 MissingInformation Handling 7 Prepare a missinginformation request Aufforderung listing precisely which mandatory fields or documents are outstanding 8 Route the request for human review before dispatch the ZeroGap Agent drafts the communication but does not send it unattended 9 Send the request to the applicant or their authorized representative json.text: Zero Gap Agent Completeness Check Operating Procedure How the Zero Gap Agent checks initial longterm care applications for missing information before the formal medical assessment NordCare Pflegekasse LongTerm Care Claims Operations 1 Purpose This procedure defines how the Zero Gap Agent scans initial applications for longterm care benefits Antrag auf Leistungen der Pflegeversicherung object Care Application and flags missing legal or personal parameters before the formal medical assessment is scheduled The agent does not deny an application because details are missing Its role is to halt the pipeline and flag the file for a quick datagathering workflow so that the strict 25workingday window can be met 2 Scope Applies to initial Pflegeversicherung longterm care insurance benefit application intake only Completeness of Objection cases is out of scope for this demo The agent performs the completeness check on the Document object but ingests the caselevel timestamp the initial formless Antrag date to calculate SLA risk and track the days remaining on the statutory clock Primary inputs official multipage PDFscanned application forms formal representation authorizations Vollmacht and supplementary clinical logs 3 Mandatory Fields Validation Rules The agent verifies the presence of the following critical sections of the application form under German social security standards Form section Required fields Rule result if not met 1 Applicant Data Full name date of birth insurance number Versichertennummer current address Hard failure if the insurance number is missing or mismatched or if basic identity does not match This prevents eligibility routing 2 Legal Representation Representative name and contact legal guardian Betreuer checkbox authorized representative proxy Bevollmächtigter checkbox Conditional if yes is checked a matching power of attorney or court decree Vorsorgevollmacht Betreuungsausweis must be attached 3 Type of Benefit At least one selected care allowance Pflegegeld noncash care benefits Pflegesachleistung combination benefit Kombinationsleistung fully inpatient care Vollstationäre Pflege No selection soft warning for the 3day MD commissioning deadline hard failure drafted outreach letter for the final 25day decision phase 4 Medical Contacts Name and address of the general practitioner Hausarzt treatersspecialists optional but strongly preferred If blank flagged as a soft warning not a hard failure The insurer needs these contacts to request medical history before the assessment 5 Care Providers Contact details of the family caregiver or of the outpatient care service Ambulanter Pflegedienst Mandatory only if Pflegegeld Pflegesachleistung or Kombinationsleistung is selected 6 Execution Date location and signature wet or digital Hard failure if unsigned Unsigned forms cannot legally initiate processing 7 SLA Triggers Accelerated statutory deadline triggers eg hospitalization inpatient rehab family care leave checkboxes or keywords If detected the agent overrides the standard 25day clock and tags the case Urgent SLA 5Day10Day 8 Civil Servant Beamter Civil service subsidy office Beihilfestelle checkbox For civil servant applications the checkbox must be verified so that costsplitting is configured correctly Happypath checks are hardcoded in the agent prompt Edge cases missing documents civil service powerofattorney mismatch benefittype conditional logic are pulled live from ARIS via MCP Completeness rules are maintained as one SOPstyle policy document per benefit type eg Completeness Policy Pflegegeld v12 written in insurer voice listing required fields legal basis and escalation rule and stored as an ARISattached satellite document 4 Completeness Check Procedure 1 The check fires on the document ingestion event 2 The agent timestamps the case from first applicant contact the formless Antrag date separately from when it runs the completeness check The 25workingday statutory clock starts at first contact independent of when the document arrives 3 The agent links the document to the case It matches by insurance number Versichertennummer if present otherwise it uses a probabilistic match on name date of birth date of application Every nonexact match is flagged assumed link no primary key 4 The agent scans for accelerated statutory deadline triggers Section 3 row 7 If detected it overrides the standard 25day clock and tags the case Urgent SLA 5Day10Day 5 The agent validates each form section against Section 3 including the Beihilfestelle check for civil servant applications and records every hard failure and soft warning 6 If a care diary Pflegetagebuch or hospital discharge report Entlassungsbericht is present the agent catalogs it as a verified attachment and ties it to the case file for the medical appraiser only if an exact primary key match exists If the case link is an assumed link probabilistic match these medical documents are strictly quarantined for human verification 7 The agent calculates SLA risk and the days remaining on the statutory clock from the caselevel timestamp 8 The agent returns a binary result Ready for Assessment or Missing Information with a structured list of the specific missing or failed fields 5 MissingInformation Handling 9 Escalation branch If information is missing the agent may escalate to the case manager with a plainlanguage summary of the gap 10 Outreach branch Alternatively the agent drafts an outreach letter to the applicant requesting the missing items 11 All drafted outreach letters and case manager escalations are placed in the humanintheloop queue each visibly tagged with a dynamic countdown timer Days to SLA Breach so that caseworkers prioritize requests that pause the penalty clock 12 No outbound communication letter or escalation leaves the system without human review and signoff There is no autosend under any condition 13 All agent outputs flags notifications drafted letters are issued in German 6 Roles Zero Gap Agent runs the completeness check on ingested documents links documents to cases detects SLA triggers returns the binary result and drafts outreach letters or escalations for human review Caseworker reviews and signs off drafted letters and escalations in the humanintheloop queue prioritizing by the Days to SLA Breach countdown Case Manager receives agent escalations with a plainlanguage summary of the gap Human verifier verifies care diaries and discharge reports quarantined because of an assumed case link Medical appraiser receives the verified attachments tied to the case file 7 Escalation When information is missing the agent may escalate to the case manager with a plainlanguage summary of the gap as an alternative to drafting an outreach letter Escalations follow the same rules as letters they are placed in the humanintheloop queue with the Days to SLA Breach countdown and require human review and signoff before leaving the system Medical documents linked through an assumed link are quarantined for human verification rather than cataloged 8 Agent Output Closure Criteria Binary result recorded Ready for Assessment or Missing Information Structured list of the specific missing or failed fields Case timestamp from first applicant contact and days remaining on the statutory clock Deadline tag standard 25day clock or Urgent SLA 5Day10Day Caselink status exact match on insurance number or assumed link no primary key Attachment status care diary discharge report cataloged as verified or quarantined for human verification Every outbound letter or escalation carries human signoff before it leaves the system 9 Legal Local Rules Applied Formless Antrag precedent In Germany a care application is legally valid from the day a single sentence requesting care is received even by phone or email Statutory clocks 25workingday statutory window starting at first applicant contact 3day deadline for commissioning the Medical Service MD Accelerated deadlines hospitalization inpatient rehab or family care leave triggers override the standard 25day clock with a 5day or 10day deadline Validity of the application unsigned forms cannot legally initiate processing without a selected benefit type the application cannot be legally prioritized or calculated Civil servants civil servant Beamter applications require the Beihilfestelle checkbox for correct costsplitting 10 Open Points Output language German only or also English is marked TBD The background specification describes a bilingual GermanEnglish notification payload Type of Benefit the requirements set a soft warning for the 3day deadline and a hard failure for the 25day phase the background specification describes it as a hard failure This procedure follows the requirements Escalation vs outreach the criteria for choosing escalation versus outreach are not specified Human verifier the role that performs human verification of quarantined medical documents is not specified Illustrative fictitious document prepared for internal demonstration purposes NordCare Pflegekasse is a fictitious insurer Not an approved operational json.text: Deadline Escalation Procedure Managing the statutory commissioning and decision clocks for longterm care applications NordCare Pflegekasse LongTerm Care Claims Operations 1 Purpose This procedure defines how NordCare Pflegekasse determines tracks pauses and escalates the statutory deadlines that apply to longterm care applications from application receipt through to the written carelevel decision 2 Scope Applies to every application for determination or change of longterm care need from the point of receipt to dispatch of the written decision Bescheid Covers deadlinetype determination the 3workingday Medical Service commissioning window pauseresume handling and escalation when a deadline is at risk or missed 3 Deadline Types Fristtyp Deadline type Trigger condition Legal basis 5 working days Applicant is currently in hospital or an inpatient rehabilitation facility 18a Abs 5 SGB XI assessment must be completed by the 5th working day after application receipt 10 working days Applicant is in a home environment not receiving palliative care and caregiver leave Pflegezeit Familienpflegezeit has been announced or agreed with the employer 18a Abs 6 SGB XI assessment must be completed within 10 working days of application receipt 25 working days standard All other cases the default deadline type unless an expedited trigger applies 18c Abs 1 Satz 1 SGB XI standard written decision deadline Deadline type is determined at intake based on the applicants situation as stated in the application it does not depend on whether the order information is complete 4 Clock Start Pause and Resume Rules 1 Both the 3workingday commissioning clock and the applicable decision clock 5 10 25 working days start on the date the application is received regardless of completeness 2 The insurer must commission the Medical Service within 3 working days of receipt using a secure electronic channel based on the mandatory order information available at that point see the Completeness Check MissingInformation Work Instruction 3 If mandatory order information is missing the decision clock is paused only from the day the applicant receives the missinginformation request not from the day the gap was identified and not automatically 4 If the request is delayed after the gap is confirmed the days between confirmation and dispatch still count against the decision deadline 5 The decision clock resumes on the day the requested information is received back at NordCare Pflegekasse 6 Log clockstart pausestart pauseend and clockresume dates in the case file for every application 5 Escalation Triggers and Levels Level Trigger Action owner Level 1 Case Handler Case approaching 70 of the applicable decision deadline with no missinginformation request yet issued Case Handler reviews and either progresses the case or issues a missinginformation request without delay Level 2 Team Lead Mandatory 3workingday commissioning window is at risk or applicant has not responded to a missinginformation request within the locally agreed followup period Team Lead reviews case status confirms whether a further request or direct outreach is warranted and reassigns capacity if needed Level 3 Process Owner Standard 25workingday or shortened decision deadline has been missed triggering the statutory penalty or a recurring pattern of missed deadlines is identified Process Owner logs the penalty trigger confirms root cause and reports the case in the governance review 6 Escalation Record Minimum Data Case reference and applicant identification Deadline type and applicable decision date Date of application receipt and pauseresume dates if applicable Current process step and case handler Reason for escalation and requested action Named receiving owner and next review date 7 Penalty and Compliance Consequences If NordCare Pflegekasse fails to issue its written decision within the applicable deadline it must pay the applicant 70 for every started week the deadline is exceeded continuing until the decision is issued This penalty does not apply where the delay is not attributable to NordCare Pflegekasse in which case the deadline is paused until the delay is resolved Legal basis 18c Abs 5 SGB XI 8 Roles Case Handler monitors deadline status for assigned cases and triggers Level 1 escalation ZeroGap Agent surfaces cases approaching a deadline threshold and flags whether a missinginformation request is outstanding Team Lead owns Level 2 escalations and followup on nonresponsive applicants Process Owner owns Level 3 escalations penalty tracking and periodic governance review 9 Governance The Process Owner reviews deadline performance monthly including cases approaching or exceeding statutory deadlines penalty payments triggered and recurring root causes eg systematic delay in issuing missinginformation requests 10 Legal Regulatory References 33 Abs 1 SGB XI benefits and the decision process begin upon application Antragsprinzip 18a Abs 5 und 6 SGB XI 5 and 10workingday expedited assessment deadlines 18 Abs 1 SGB XI 3workingday Medical Service commissioning deadline 18c Abs 1 SGB XI standard 25workingday written decision deadline 18c Abs 5 SGB XI 70perweek penalty for missed decision deadlines and conditions for nonattributable delay 18c Abs 6 SGB XI pause and resume mechanism for missing mandatory documents 37 SGB X rules on notificationdelivery Bekanntgabe of written or electronic decisions Illustrative fictitious document prepared for internal demonstration purposes NordCare Pflegekasse is a fictitious insurer Not an approved operational policy
